columns.article_id: Join key, as in the shared corpus
columns.title: Headline with the outlet suffix removed
columns.article_type: news_report, opinion, explainer, transcript or other (assigned by the model)
columns.main_country: The country the article is mainly about (assigned by the model)
columns.used_in_topic_views: True if the article passes the Australia filter and is therefore counted in the topic views
columns.dominant_frame: One of the eight frame labels
columns.frame_reason: One sentence on why the frame fits
columns.quotes_checked: Number of quotations and key phrases checked against the article
columns.quotes_exact: Number of those found word for word

columns.kind: key_point (something the article reports) or key_language (a phrase that shows the framing)
columns.speaker: For key points, who makes the claim; for key language, narration or quoted_source
columns.quote: Quotation given by the model as evidence
columns.sentence_id: Sentence in which the quotation was found, or the one cited if it was not found
columns.sentence: Full text of that sentence, for display as context
columns.quote_status: exact, near or missing; display only exact

columns.articles: Number of the outlet's articles on the topic with this frame
columns.publisher_total: Number of the outlet's articles on the topic across all frames
columns.thin: True if publisher_total is below MIN_ARTICLES

topic_outlets.json.description: Outlet view. Per topic: overview, outlets (one card each: article counts, thin flag, frame counts, top frame, article types, example articles), outlet_patterns and differences. Show patterns and differences with status 'ok'.

topic_stances.json.description: Stance view. Per topic: overview, articles_per_stance, outlets_per_stance, stance_summaries (summary, emphasis, key_claims with verified_support quotations and a human_review verdict) and differences. The groups come from the political leaning component's labels. Show claims whose human_review is 'yes'; status 'ok' only means the quotation was found.
